childNodes.textContent: Useful Magic Studio (“we”, “us”) operates this marketing website. Privacy questions:

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Add business address / registered entity details if required.

If you email us or subscribe to our newsletter, we process the information you choose to share (such as your email address) to respond or manage the subscription. Newsletter data is processed by Kit under their terms and privacy policy and is not sent to PostHog.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: List exact form fields, retention for contact messages, and any other processors.
site functionality, security, storing your privacy preference, and privacy-minimized Sentry error reporting when legally appropriate.
persistent PostHog analytics and Sentry Session Replay. These run only after you accept.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Confirm legal bases for essential error monitoring vs optional analytics/replay under applicable law.
for product/marketing analytics. PostHog Session Replay is disabled. We do not call identify APIs at this stage and do not send names, emails, form contents, or authentication tokens to PostHog.
We may capture explicit events such as:
Newsletter signup completion (without form field values)

If you reject optional analytics, PostHog remains in cookieless measurement mode: it does not store analytics cookies or local identifiers for persistent tracking, and may count visitors using a privacy-preserving server-side hash. See PostHog’s

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Describe IP handling / discard settings and any limitations (daily uniqueness, no cross-device linking).
If you accept optional analytics, PostHog may use first-party persistence (for example cookies or local storage) to measure returning visits and funnels more accurately until you withdraw consent.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: List cookie/storage names, durations, and exact purposes after counsel review.

for application error monitoring. Error events are scrubbed to reduce personal data (for example request bodies, cookies, headers, and sensitive query parameters). Default PII sending is disabled in our SDK configuration. IP storage should also be disabled in Sentry project settings where available.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Confirm whether essential error monitoring operates without consent under applicable privacy policy and laws.

Sentry Session Replay starts only after you accept optional analytics and session recording. Replay sampling is zero until then. When enabled, text and inputs are masked by default, media is blocked, and sensitive elements/forms are excluded. Replay stops immediately if you withdraw consent.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Add retention period for replays and any regional processing details.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Map each processing activity to purpose and legal basis (e.g. legitimate interests, consent, contract).
Current processors may include PostHog, Sentry, Kit, and our hosting provider (for example Vercel). Each has its own privacy documentation.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Add transfer mechanisms (SCCs, etc.) and processing locations.

childNodes.textContent: State retention for analytics events, error events, replays, consent records, and contact/newsletter data.

attributes.class: rounded-md border border-dashed border-[#6f42c1]/40 bg-[#f2f2da]/60 px-3 py-2 text-[15px] italic text-[#2f4f4f]/opacity-90

childNodes.textContent: Describe applicable rights (access, deletion, objection, etc.) and how to submit a request.
You can change or withdraw optional analytics and session recording anytime using

or the footer link. Withdrawal stops Sentry Replay, opts out of persistent PostHog capture, and removes PostHog analytics identifiers where supported, while keeping the essential record of your preference.
We may update this page from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top reflects the latest revision.
